grounding.observation: Actual c3 front/reverse and shot images were inspected and rejected; original source roles and accepted quality floor remain.
grounding.comparison: C3 is a failure control, not the artistic baseline.

expert_coverage.observation: Garment support, cloth mechanics, cache transfer and evidence camera evaluation have explicit methods and discriminating tests.
expert_coverage.comparison: This covers a two-actor method proof, not all remaining production appearance work.

film_alignment.observation: The accepted film quality remains the target; daylight Pashtun is not a lighting prescription for this night shot.
film_alignment.comparison: A settled shirt alone cannot admit the weak face, beard or helmet-like headwear.

preferences.observation: Internal evidence precedes propagation; Director is not asked to choose cloth parameters.
preferences.comparison: The last correction does not relax the quality floor or authorize a knowingly failing handoff.

reference_roles.observation: Faithful motion source and supporting visual identity remain separate from same-film quality comparator.
reference_roles.comparison: Temporary diagnostic cameras do not replace production shots or motion reference.

method.observation: Reviewed isolated scene cleanup, finite/topology/displacement guards, seam pins and all-cache application.46 focused tests pass. Built-in cloth is an actual change from analytic envelope construction.
method.comparison: Native cloth execution is untested; convergence, underarm integrity and pose transfer are hypotheses to reject with actual output.

interfaces.observation: Candidate5 remains parent; only central torso displacement transfers, old panel is removed over continuous shirt, shoulder/waist limits are pinned and sash refitted. Camera transform is evaluated before capture.
interfaces.comparison: No static proof qualifies movement contacts; crest and reverse can reject even a numerically bounded delta.

efficient_quality.observation: Two actors and five images remain the early proof, avoiding full-sequence render before appearance clears.
efficient_quality.comparison: No further code/test progress is counted as audience-visible success.

authority.observation: Existing appearance task cycle4/max4 retains all failures and exact337 approval; motion allowance is separate.
authority.comparison: No new spending, provider, installation, upload, accepted-master edit or implicit extra correction.

strongest_counterexample: The collision proxy is derived from a shirt, not anatomy. The solver may merely settle an already wrong form; transferring a static delta to animated poses may break contacts. Even a better garment leaves face and headwear failures. All of these veto artistic admission; this is a bounded method trial only.
